$comment: Each entry declares one focused solution: the entry points it is rooted at, the build types
it offers, and the platform boundaries its project closure must not cross.
'configurations' becomes the .slnx <BuildType> list and defaults to Debug/Release when
omitted. It has to name every configuration anyone builds THROUGH the solution: MSBuild
answers MSB4126 for one a solution does not declare, before it evaluates a project. The
runtime-identifier-pinned names (Release-Windows, Release-Linux) are deliberately absent --
they are published per project, which is why CI's publish job is a project-level build.
Debug-VM/Release-VM build the browser against the Broiler.VM JavaScript profile. That
profile arrives as the Broiler.HtmlBridge.Scripting.Vm PACKAGE, conditional on the -VM pair,
and a package is not a project a solution lists -- so these solutions hold the same src/
projects under all four build types, and what the -VM pair changes is the restore, not the
